meta.title: Add customizable PostgreSQL connection pool settings
meta.body_summary: Add explicit connection pool with configurable min_size, max_size, and max_idle settings for PostgreSQL, plus documentation updates.

perf_labels.notes: Small pool config change merged quickly without review; post-merge code reading revealed context manager issue, leading to full revert in a follow-up PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 64 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround modification and the rapid merge is consistent with its low-risk appearance, though later issues surfaced.

review_details.concern_detail: Post-merge, maver1ck noted that the new get_postgres_saver() returned an AsyncPostgresSaver directly instead of an async context manager, breaking usage in initialize_database(). JoshuaC215 later agreed and reverted the change in #209.
review_details.performance_claim: Customizable PostgreSQL connection pool settings for better connection management.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent correctly added a configurable pool but missed the requirement to return an async context manager, indicating a gap in understanding complex Python async patterns and existing code contracts.

detection_detail.code_reading: maver1ck reviewed the code post-merge and identified the context manager issue; no prior review during merge
detection_detail.ci_auto: codecov[bot] reported low test coverage (22% patch, 7 missing lines) but did not block merge

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks, profiler data, or reproducibility steps provided; the change was purely structural.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After maver1ck's review comment, JoshuaC215 reverted the entire pool customization in a subsequent PR (#209), moving back to the default langgraph connection setup.

core_change_summary.description: In src/memory/postgres.py, added create_connection_pool() function that builds an AsyncConnectionPool from configured min_size, max_size, and max_idle settings. Updated get_postgres_saver() to instantiate the saver with the pool instead of calling from_conn_string. Also modified .env.example, README.md, __init__.py, and sqlite.py for documentation and minor adjustments.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Non-core changes include env example entries and readme update; __init__.py and sqlite.py changes are minor conflict resolutions or support.
change_trajectory: Initial Claude Code commit: added pool creation and modified saver function.
JoshuaC215 merged commit resolving conflicts and finalizing pool config.
Post-merge review by maver1ck pointed out context manager issue.
JoshuaC215 acknowledged the problem and later reverted the entire change in PR #209.

review_signals.summary: Questioned whether returning AsyncPostgresSaver directly would work, as previous code used an async context manager in initialize_database().
Agreed with the concern, noted that the change was reverted in #209 and decided to stick with langgraph default.
Codecov bot reported low patch coverage (22%) and 7 missing lines; not blocking.

collaboration_trajectory: Claude Code generated PR with pool settings and documentation changes.
PR merged by JoshuaC215 within ~13.5 hours; no pre-merge human review or comments.
3 days later, maver1ck added a formal review questioning the context manager compatibility.
Author responded ~6 days later agreeing and later reverted the change entirely in a follow-up PR.
